2609.11636.title: MAPLE: Memory-Augmented Planning with Language and Evolution
2609.11636.paper_summary: Domain practitioners understand their business constraints but may lack operations-research expertise or dedicated support. LLM-based optimization agents translate natural-language requirements into models or solver programs that established optimization tools can execute. This progress makes optimization more accessible, but real-world operations are dynamic: changing demand, resources, and priorities require updates to data, constraints, and objectives. Methods centered on isolated requests offer limited support for rapid adaptation that preserves earlier decisions and reuses useful search results. We introduce MAPLE (Memory-Augmented Planning with Language and Evolution), an agent for maintaining optimization problems through successive natural-language requests. MAPLE combines language-based problem construction with mathematical programming and evolutionary search. It retains the optimization program, accepted plans, earlier updates, and candidate solutions for subsequent requests. We introduce NLDO, a benchmark of 15 trajectories and 180 updates spanning selection, scheduling, rostering, routing, and cloud-resource placement. In the main evaluation, MAPLE completes all trajectories and achieves online scalar quality of 0.951 and a Pareto hypervolume ratio of 0.875. Controlled comparisons further show that maintaining executable state improves update validity and can preserve useful search information across substantial revisions.
2609.11636.paper_summary_zh: 域內實踐者了解他們的業務限制，但可能缺乏運籌學專業知識或專門支持。基於LLM的優化代理將自然語言需求轉換為模型或求解程序，這些模型或程序可以被已建立的優化工具執行。這一進展使得優化變得更加可及，但現實世界的操作是動態的：不斷變化的需求、資源和優先事項需要對數據、約束和目標進行更新。以孤立請求為中心的方法對於快速適應提供的支持有限，這樣的適應需要保留早期決策並重用有用的搜索結果。我們介紹MAPLE（基於語言和演化的記憶增強規劃），這是一個通過連續的自然語言請求來維護優化問題的代理。MAPLE結合了基於語言的問題構建、數學編程和演化搜索。它保留了優化程序、接受的計劃、早期的更新和後續請求的候選解。我們介紹NLDO，這是一個包含15條軌跡和180次更新的基準，涵蓋選擇、調度、排班、路由和雲資源配置。在主要評估中，MAPLE完成了所有軌跡，並達到了0.951的在線標量質量和0.875的Pareto超體積比。受控比較進一步顯示，維持可執行狀態可以改善更新的有效性，並能在大規模修訂中保留有用的搜索信息。
